ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, which species would most directly be affected if all the figs die?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows that this is a food web: in the bottom middle there is a "Strangler Figs" box, with arrows nearby pointing to animals; among them, an arrow can be seen pointing directly upward from "Strangler Figs" to "Langur". According to the relationship in a food web where arrows indicate from food source to consumer, if all figs died, the species directly dependent on them would be most directly affected. Therefore the answer is langur.
